Additionally, Article 5 (Section 5.1) grants SutroVax the right to perform site audits and inspect Facilities and records related to the performance of the Supply Agreement, including verifying compliance with specifications and laws. The audit rights are unilateral (SutroVax auditing Sutro) and subject to reasonable notice and confidentiality obligations.
